newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Nov 5.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not gaurantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.

- Presient Kim vows to launch campaign to eliminate corruption and irregularities. Prosecution investigation of irregularities involving public servants will continue, according to the Prosecutor-General.
- Share prices tumbled on Monday to a three-year low on talk of the government's anti-corruption campaign against corrupt officials.
- Samsung Electronics develops 1-gigabit DRAM for the first time in the world.
- Two armed North Korean guerrilla suspects sighted yesterday afternnon, and South Korean troops launch nightlong search operation.
- President Kim renewed his commitment to fighting corruption and misconduct in Korean society.
- Share prices on the Seoul stock market plunged to the lowest level in three years with the composite stock price index falling below 750.
- South Korean and Russia agreed to step up military ties and defense ministers signed a memorandum of understanding to promote cooperation in defense.
- The government unveiled tax, financial and administrative incentives available to private companies so that they can more actively participate in public infrastructure projects.
